run_f_gold: run f_gold to perform a recursive binary search on a sorted array and return the index of a key
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple sorted array inputs to verify it correctly finds key indices
review_f_gold: review f_gold which implements recursive binary search with integer mid calculation
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that searches for a key in a sorted array using recursive divide-and-conquer
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use iterative binary search instead of recursion
